anim_set_lock.FIGHT: every move in this file: moveset moves and combat stances — the combat animation bank
anim_set_lock.SHOW: win poses, intro poses, taunts, cutscene animations — intro/win slots and cutscenes ONLY; tracked in docs/anim/NINA-ANIM-GAP-20261023.md; must NEVER enter this moveset without the user's explicit approval
anim_set_lock.note: per-move 'set' tags stamp what each pull lane added; the file itself is the FIGHT set

frame_convention: T3 60fps -> seconds; damage scaled T3 170HP -> WH 100HP

generated_full_moveset.note: Full T3 bank depth merged over curated base; curated moves preserved verbatim. 413 rows, 242 attacks.

forward_merge.method: semantic union of branch (moveset-cluster-a-t8) and main versions; main keeps contested move keys, branch entries rekeyed <key>_t8 with t8_input recorded; colliding branch specials appended with forward_merge_alt_of

t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.
